executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-28 examined eight relevant reports; there is no confirmed material change in direction at present. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but they will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
